The billionaires behind Claude just got a lot richer.

Anthropic priced its IPO at A$124 a share, valuing the company at A$2.2 trillion and adding A$73 billion to the fortunes of its cofounders and early investors.

The seven cofounders, led by CEO Dario Amodei, saw their combined net worth rise A$59.6 billion to A$208.6 billion, or roughly A$29.7 billion each. Between them they hold nearly 9% of the company and keep control through a share carrying 50.1% of the voting power.
